The property to be sold is located in the Township of Edison, in the County of Middlesex and the State of New Jersey.

SUBJECT TO ANY OPEN TAXES. WATER AND/OR SEWER CHARGES INCLUDING CERT. NO. 24-00615 FOR THE YEAR 2024 TAX SOLD DECEMBER 16. 2024 IN THE AMOUNT OF $11,938.31 PLUS INTEREST WITH SUBSEQUENT CHARGES OF $5,729.60 PLUS INTEREST, PLUS 3RI) QUARTER 2025, PLUS INTEREST, IF ANY, AS OF THE TIME OF SALE.
